title: File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents will soon be available by default for compliance security profile workspaces with supported compliance standards
body:
Starting November 15, 2026, file upload in Genie One and Genie Agents will be available by default for workspaces that have the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled, if the workspace's compliance standard supports file upload. You can upload files to a conversation and analyze them in natural language alongside your other data.

Workspaces with a compliance standard that doesn't support file upload yet can't use it. To check whether your standard supports file upload, open its page from the list of supported [compliance standards](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile#compliance-security-profile-overview) and see the feature availability table.

See [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file) and [Upload a file to a Genie Agent](/aws/en/genie-agents/file-upload).
